scientific_question: Can StructMem be bound to a complete immutable official source tree with an executable-code and license audit before adapter design?
decision_informed: Whether StructMem may enter a separate fail-closed WMA adapter feasibility and lifecycle design gate.
scientific_evidence_role: engineering source-identity gate only; no import, dependency, lifecycle, benchmark, numerical, superiority, or SOTA claim is permitted

execution_contract.server_root_injection: Set AGENT_ENHANCE_REMOTE_ROOT immediately before execution; it must resolve to a writable project root named AgentEnhance under /data1 or /data2.
execution_contract.network: one ordinary Git HTTPS clone of the exact small public source repository; no model or dataset download
execution_contract.wave1_non_interference: The source-only clone may run while Wave1 is active because it does not install dependencies, download models or datasets, load models, call APIs, start services, or use GPUs.

admission_rule: The exact commit is detached, clean, and matches the frozen official repository.
All tracked regular files have retained relative paths, byte sizes, and SHA-256 values.
The checkout contains an MIT LICENSE file.
The source contains no submodule, unresolved Git LFS pointer, or model-like weight file.
The source and evidence roots were absent before execution and remain unique.
The evidence root contains TERMINAL_ACCEPTED, no TERMINAL_REJECTED, and a verified evidence inventory.
failure_rule: Any collision, clone error, identity mismatch, dirty state, missing or non-MIT license, submodule, LFS pointer, weight-like file, byte-ceiling breach, or timeout seals the fresh evidence root TERMINAL_REJECTED. Preserve the partial source and do not retry or repair it in place.
next_gate_after_acceptance: Independently audit the source inventory and identify the exact StructMem execution path. Source acceptance alone never authorizes dependency installation, lifecycle execution, or numerical execution.
prohibited_actions: using a moving branch name as an execution identity
treating the repository-wide LightMem name as the ACL 2026 LightMem method
installing dependencies or downloading models during source materialization
starting a lifecycle or numerical run from this gate
using source-reported scores as local reproduction values
deleting a rejected or partial source root
